import os
import sys
from cyhole import Helius

def main():
    api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        print("Error: HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    wallet_address = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else input("Enter wallet address: ")
    
    helius = Helius(api_key=api_key)
    assets = helius.get_assets_by_owner(owner=wallet_address)
    
    print(assets)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import sys
from cyhole import Helius

def main():
    api_key = os.getenv("HELIUS_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        print("Error: HELIUS_API_KEY environment variable not set", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    wallet_address = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else input("Enter wallet address: ")
    
    helius = Helius(api_key=api_key)
    assets = helius.get_assets_by_owner(owner=wallet_address)
    
    print(assets)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
